units: percentage points of E014's qualified agreement Q against the own founder; block means over the eight founder x recipient lineages; scored on the 128 development blocks

parts.words: 128 bytes: D(256) - D(16), the lower side
128 bytes: D(256) - D(16), the upper side

statements.H1: Renewal keeps the record against no record: after 256 rewrites, records renewed from an acquired record (own or foreign) stay far above records renewed from no record, at both budgets.
statements.H2: At 128 bytes the founder-specific contrast is flat from 16 to 256 rewrites: D(256) - D(16) lies in [-0.5, +0.2].
statements.H3: Renewal does not recover the protected copy's fidelity: after 256 rewrites own-record renewal stays below the protected own copy, at both budgets.

prespecified_measurements.M-a, the reference and R_H: Delta_P and R_H(n) at both budgets and every checkpoint, numerator, denominator and ratio together; the ratio reported only if the reference's 95% lower bound is at least half its estimate; R_H well below 1 at 16: renewal keeps a fraction of the protected records' readable specificity; near 1: nearly all; above 1: renewal makes the founders' difference more readable than a protected copy does
prespecified_measurements.M-b, the asymptote: hs001.fit on D(n) and R_H(n) at each budget: a plateau above zero, a plateau indistinguishable from zero, a plateau below zero, or not identified within 256 rewrites (M1's 95% upper bound of h above 64); M1 a decay or a rise (a free in sign); M2's c, the late mean and slope beside it
prespecified_measurements.M-c, the 2,048-byte decline: D(16) - D(1) at 2,048 bytes (the reviewer's Figure 4D) with its interval; the same at 128 bytes
prespecified_measurements.M-d, the replicate concordance: same-founder less cross-founder sign agreement of the decoded records at every checkpoint and lineage arm; a lasting excess for rewrite and foreign well above the founder-free arms (erased, background) reads as basins kept, one at their level as mixing; it measures initial-condition information kept, D measures closeness to the founder's prototype against a foreign founder's lineages
prespecified_measurements.M-e, the floors' course: Q(rewrite) - Q(erased) and Q(rewrite) - Q(background) at every checkpoint, M1 fitted to the first

rules.ratio: reported as a ratio only if the reference's 95% lower bound >= 0.5 x its estimate
rules.fit: hs001.fit (PLAN_HS001.md): M1 c + a rho^(n-1) by profile least squares on the 16 checkpoint means, M0, M2; 10,000 whole-block resamples, rng('E014', 'bootstrap')
rules.identified: M1's 95% upper bound of the half-life <= 64 rewrites
